posts.text: International exchange trade funds (ETFs) will stop accepting fresh inflows. Here's what it means — I was also planning to start investing internationally, so I’ve been keeping an eye on this. Unfortunately, there doesn’t seem to be any clear update. In June 2026, AMFI again asked SEBI to increase the $7 billion overseas investment limit. So, there is still no fixed date for a complete reopening. It depends on the individual fund and the available investment limit.
